nodes.description: Boolean flag controlling whether the burn/reward game logic is active in transfers.
Address of the ETH-X20 Uniswap liquidity pool used to decide reward eligibility.
Monotonic counter mixed into keccak256 pseudo-randomness.
Owner-supplied randomness seed used by _play.
Derived randomness seed used by burn-rate and _play.
Declared chance rate (set to 100) but never actually used in game logic.
Constructor that mints the entire 10000e18 supply to the deployer and sets gameStarted=false.
onlyOwner function that configures liquidity pool and seeds and flips gameStarted to true.
ERC20 transfer override that routes msg.sender through _getAmount before calling super.transfer.
ERC20 transferFrom override that routes the amount through _getAmount before calling super.transferFrom.
Public view returning the gameStarted flag.
Private hook that plays the game, mints rewards and burns tokens before the real transfer occurs.
Private function that mints 10x the amount to the recipient when the sender is the liquidity pool and _play wins.
Private function computing a pseudo-random burn between ~1% and 10% of the amount.
Public game function returning true when two pseudo-random values derived from seeds collide.
Private PRNG using keccak256 of nonce, seed, now, block.difficulty and msg.sender modulo a bound.
Attacker-controlled caller address, used both as the token sender and as PRNG entropy.
now/block.timestamp used as entropy in _randModulus, miner-influenceable.
_mint(recipient, amount.mul(10)) creates unbacked tokens before balance state is updated.
_burn(sender, burnAmount) destroys user tokens inside the transfer flow using a predictable random amount.
Weak on-chain randomness: keccak256(nonce, seed, now, block.difficulty, msg.sender) is predictable/manipulable.
nonce++ state mutation that re-seeds the PRNG on every call, cheaply grindable by the caller.
_liquidityPool parameter of startGame, assigned to the liquidityPool state variable.
_seed1 parameter of startGame, assigned to seed1 and used to derive seed2.
recipient parameter of transfer.
amount parameter of transfer, passed through _getAmount.
sender parameter of transferFrom.
recipient parameter of transferFrom.
amount parameter of transferFrom, passed through _getAmount.
recipient parameter of _getAmount, target of reward minting.
sender parameter of _getAmount, source of burned tokens.
amount parameter of _getAmount, used for burn subtraction and reward multiplication.
Local burnAmount computed from _getRandomBurnedAmount and subtracted from the transfer amount.
amount parameter of _sendReward, multiplied by 10 on a win.
sender parameter of _sendReward, compared against liquidityPool.
recipient parameter of _sendReward, mint target on a win.
amount parameter of _getRandomBurnedAmount, divided by the burn rate.
Local burnrate derived from _randModulus(90, seed2) used in the burn computation.
First pseudo-random value in _play derived from seed1.
Second pseudo-random value in _play derived from seed2.
mod parameter of _randModulus, the modulus bound for the PRNG.
seed parameter of _randModulus, the seed mixed into the hash.
Local rand result of the keccak256 modulo computation.
